description_for_human: Contract renewals and decision deadlines from the Contoso VMO register.
description_for_model: Use this plugin for questions about Contoso vendor contract renewals: renewal dates, yearly cost, budget owner, decide-by and escalation dates, and to create a decision reminder for a vendor.

functions.name: listRenewals
functions.description: Lists vendor contract renewals sorted by renewal date, with decide-by and escalation dates. Optional filters: withinDays (renewals due within N days of today) and owner.

functions.name: getVendor
functions.description: Returns one vendor record by vendorId, for example fabrikam-cloud.

functions.name: createDecisionReminder
functions.description: Creates a decision reminder for the budget owner of a vendor. Needs vendorId, remindOn (YYYY-MM-DD, not after the decide-by date) and an optional note.

confirmation.title: Create decision reminder
confirmation.body: Create this reminder in the Contoso VMO register?

conversation_starters.title: Renewals
conversation_starters.text: Which vendor renewals are due in the next 90 days?
